svg.text: W13 · Shared data grid: paging, incremental loading, cards on phones · AWK-19 · 2026-10-14
One grid in packages/ui for every list. Paging by default; the response list loads more as you scroll. Sorting on the columns that can sort, numbers right-aligned in mono, a card per row on phones.
A · Surveys (W6) on the grid · paging, sort by column · EN · desktop
Page, sort and page size are kept in the address (?page=2&sort=changed-desc), so Back and shared links return to the same place.
B · Results → Antworten · lädt beim Scrollen nach · DE · desktop
Am Ende: „Alle 1.248 geladen.“ · Die erste Spalte bleibt beim seitlichen Scrollen stehen, die Kopfzeile beim Scrollen nach unten.
C · Results → Participants · paging with row selection (only where a screen needs it) · EN · desktop
The header box selects this page; a line above the grid then offers “Select all 640”, which selects every match across pages.
D · Phone: one card per row · EN surveys (paging) · DE responses (scroll)
E · States (Surveys, EN; DE copy in grey)
Skeleton rows, no spinner; header and pager stay.
No surveys yet. Start from a template or blank.
Noch keine Umfragen. Mit einer Vorlage oder leer beginnen. ·
Keine Umfrage passt zu „pulse 2025“. · Suche löschen
Not loaded. The server did not answer.
Nicht geladen. Der Server hat nicht geantwortet. · Erneut ve
Phone rule: under 768 px every row is a card. The first column is the card's title, the
next two share a line, the rest show as label and value. Columns marked “hidden on phone”
(answers after Q3) are left out; tapping the card opens the full row. Sorting moves into
one Sort menu, because there are no headers to click.

1 Header: labels in mono caps; the active sort is dark with ↓ or ↑; ↕ marks the other columns that can sort; the rest cannot. Sorting is done by the server, so it covers every page, not only the one shown.
2 Alignment: text left; numbers, durations and dates right in mono (Plex Mono), so figures line up. Rows 40 px, light fill on hover; where a row opens something, the whole row is the target.
3 Paging is the default: 50 per page (25 / 50 / 100, remembered per grid on this device), page numbers with … for long lists. The survey list moves from “Show more” to this.
4 Responses keep their cursor: newest first, or oldest first by clicking Begonnen. Other columns do not sort here, because sorting 1 M answers per question would break the 200 ms budget.
5 Responses load the next 50 when the end comes into view; “Weitere laden” does the same by hand (keyboard, screen readers). Only rows near the screen stay in the page, so 1 M responses stay smooth.
6 Clicking a response opens it on the right, as now; ↑ ↓ move between rows, Enter opens, Esc closes. For screen readers: role=grid, aria-sort, aria-rowcount with the total.
7 Selection only where a screen does something with several rows. Here: Send reminder and Remove for the selected participants (today one person at a time via ⋯).
8 Phone: cards as in D; the pager shrinks to ‹ 51–100 of 584 ›.
Email and PDF: the grid is an admin screen only and never appears in email or PDF; data leaves through Export (W11).

Open for Dražan: (a) bulk selection on Participants now (recommended), or no selection until a screen needs it; (b) page numbers (recommended) or only ‹ ›; (c) responses sort by time only (recommended).
